$note: Site logistics of the Karachi school: a 4 kanal site beside a running school in Gulshan-e-Iqbal. Heavy vehicles avoid school times; ready-mixed concrete comes from Korangi. All names are invented.

note.en: Gate for trucks and transit mixers. Flagman on duty. No movements from 07:30 to 08:00 and 13:00 to 13:30 when pupils pass.
Light vehicles and labour only. Pupils' walkway fenced off on the other side.

name.en: Laydown A - north of the building

note.en: Steel and shuttering plates, inside the boundary wall.
Bricks, sand and crush, away from the pupils' walkway.

rules_text.en: Book every delivery 24 hours ahead with Engr. Usman Shaikh. No vehicle movements while pupils arrive or leave. No waiting on the service road. Tanker water only from KWSC-authorised hydrants.

description.en: Grade 60 deformed bars with mill test certificates
Ready-mixed concrete from Korangi, poured from the truck

topic.en: SBCA stage inspection of the first-floor slab

outcome.en: Inspection done; minor comments on the stair railing.
Load sanctioned; meter to be installed after the internal wiring test.

topic.en: Head teacher of the adjacent school

outcome.en: Agreed fenced walkway and no deliveries at school times.

power_connection_point.en: K-Electric pole-mounted transformer on the service road

water_connection_point.en: KWSC line in the service road

water_consumer.en: Curing, mixing water and dust suppression

parking_note.en: Staff park inside Gate 2; labour arrive by the Qingqi from the Block 7 stop.

heavy_title.en: Ready-mixed concrete for the roof slab

heavy_route_notes.en: From Korangi via the Shahrah-e-Faisal and University Road, Sunday pour to keep clear of school days.

spoil_title.en: Surplus earth to the KMC dumping point

rebar_title.en: Grade 60 steel for the first-floor slab

rebar_destination.en: Laydown A - north of the building

dust_description.en: Dust in the classrooms of the adjacent school during the excavation.

dust_response.en: Water sprinkling three times a day, green net on the boundary wall facing the school.

complaint_reporter.en: Head teacher of the adjacent school

noise_description.en: Concrete vibrator running during the school examination week.

telecom_point.en: PTCL cabinet at the service road

oversize_conditions.en: Sunday pour notified to the traffic police.

customs_title.en: Imported solar panels for the school

rejected_cargo.en: Bricks below first class returned to the kiln
